evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL increased 4.1 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over next 28 days exceeds RETAIL_REC mean over last 28 days, or RESIDENTIAL stops increasing week-on-week within two weeks.

failure_condition: Either WORKPLACES or TRANSIT recovers above threshold within two weeks, or RETAIL_REC improves by more than 5 percentage points despite both proxies remaining in depressed state.
